root_cause.text: The ec_bhf_open() error path incorrectly passed the DMA buffer length (alloc_len) as the DMA handle argument to dma_free_coherent() instead of the correct physical address (alloc_phys), leading to improper buffer unmapping.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "dma_free_coherent() in error path takes priv->rx_buf.alloc_len as the dma handle. This would lead to improper unmapping of the buffer." The patch diff shows the change from `priv->rx_buf.alloc_len` to `priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys` in the call to dma_free_coherent().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix bug in ec_bhf_open error path where dma_free_coherent was called with buffer length instead of DMA address.
intent_record.what: Changed the fourth argument of dma_free_coherent in the error path of ec_bhf_open from priv->rx_buf.alloc_len to priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys.
intent_record.how: This corrects the DMA handle passed to dma_free_coherent to use the actual physical/DMA address obtained during allocation instead of the buffer length, ensuring proper deallocation of coherent memory.
